question: 2022年招生计划和录取人数分别是多少？
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.plan_count), 0) AS plan_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.admitted_count), 0) AS admitted_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.admitted_count), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(p.plan_count), 0), 2) AS completion_rate FROM fact.plan p JOIN dim.year y ON y.id = p.year_id LEFT JOIN fact.admission_summary s ON s.plan_id = p.id WHERE y.year_no = 2022 LIMIT 1
